Not shipped.

Retry with explicit per-item LEFT-facing callout - facing fixed correctly this time, extraction clean (8/8 at default tol), but text captions appeared despite explicit no-text instruction; min_area filter excluded them from extraction so no functional harm, still logging as a defect since instruction wasn't followed | CORRECTION: user caught the 2 sink items (single/double basin) also facing wrong direction - the other 6 items (water heaters/fridges/dishwashers) were correctly left-facing. Sinks need regeneration.

Washers/dryers/grills/smoker - facing correct on all 8, extraction clean (8/8), only text captions present (harmless, filtered by min_area) | CORRECTION: user caught Budget Top-Load Washer also facing wrong (I misjudged it as correct - top-load washers are ambiguous since the dial is on the top-front lip, not a side door, harder for me to verify visually). Other 7 items correct. Washer needs regeneration.
Redo of the 3 wrong-facing items (2 sinks + budget top-load washer) from earlier 8-item sheets - all correct this time, clean

Final correct sink orientation: cube-with-red-door reference established that the basin's FRONT APRON WALL (not the faucet) is the left-visible plane, faucet mounted at back-right. User confirmed correct. Budget single-basin also needed a follow-up divider removal + background magenta fix (2 sub-edits).
Generated 9 cells (3x3 grid) with 3 rows duplicated instead of 6 unique items in 2x3; heavy baked-in text captions and grid lines. Not extracted, not shipped. Reverting to 3-item batches.
Wood offset smoker, premium pellet smoker, budget wood stove - clean, no text, correct facing, extracted 3/3

Original smoker in the 3-item smokers3 sheet had handle/door on the wrong side per user catch. Took 2 more attempts to fix (1st redo produced broken crossed-geometry, 2nd redo got orientation right but wrong door color + missing firebox, fixed via a targeted recolor+firebox edit). Final version correct and shipped.

Gave up on asymmetric offset-firebox smoker after 5 failed facing attempts (kept misjudging orientation, one edit even broke geometry). Switched to a round/symmetric drum smoker per user direction ('just pick a round symmetrical smoker and move on') which sidesteps left/right ambiguity entirely. Final version passed QA and has no orientation risk.

Smoker saga resolved: after 6 failed attempts total, fixed by (1) switching to round symmetric drum design, (2) correcting collapsed front-elevation camera back to isometric 3/4, (3) rotating 180deg in-place (not mirrored, to preserve lighting) so vent door moved from right to left. User confirmed correct.

Standard fireplace insert, premium stone fireplace, budget 32in TV - clean, no text, correct isometric depth and left-facing fronts on all 3, extracted 3/3. Pending final user visual confirmation given today's facing-error streak.

Premium TV, budget bed, premium bed. Premium bed initially generated backwards (headboard right instead of left), fixed via 180-deg in-place rotation edit. Extraction also needed manual per-item band cropping instead of auto connected-components since drop shadows bridged adjacent items in the standard extractor. All 3 extracted and QA-passed after fixes.
Budget couch, premium sectional, budget armchair - clean, correct facing, no shadows (explicit no-shadow instruction worked - avoided the extraction-fragmentation issue from the previous sheet)
Premium recliner, budget 4-seat dining table, premium 6-seat dining table - clean, no shadows, no text. FINAL sheet - all 40 Appliances & Furniture items now generated/extracted/QA-passed.
Charcoal, fiberglass insulation batt, interior wall paint - clean, no text, correct left-facing, 3/3 extracted

Low/high capacity well pumps + hand pump wellhead - correct facing, no text, but ground shadows appeared again (despite no-shadow instruction) and merged items 2+3 into one auto-detected component. Fixed via manual band-crop extraction, same technique as the earlier TV/beds sheet. All 3 extracted clean and QA-passed.

Manual well + shower stall extracted clean from the group sheet, but Chinking initially rendered as a rigid stone/concrete ring (looked like a well liner segment) instead of a rope-like caulk material - redone individually with clearer 'coiled rope/tube, not a ring' language, which fixed it. Final set of 3 all QA-passed.
Winter Coat - solo item, first-ever clothing/apparel item in the catalog. Clean, no text, no shadow. Left/right facing convention doesn't strictly apply to a symmetric worn garment.
